about: Leonida Legend: an offline guide and tracker for the 55 official PlayStation 5 trophies of Grand Theft Auto VI. Names, descriptions and grades are shown as PlayStation publishes them; every guide is written for this entry from the official descriptions and cites its sources. Hidden flags follow the published total of 28 hidden trophies; count targets follow the published total of 21 count-based trophies; missable flags are inferences from the official descriptions and are labelled as such.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is awarded automatically once the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is nothing separate to unlock. Treat it as the final checkbox: work through the story first, then clear the collectible, activity and cumulative trophies during the cleanup stage, and this one pops on its own the moment the last of the other 54 lands.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Awarded for completing the mission Gone Fishing, an early story mission. Simply play through the opening of the campaign and finish the mission's objectives; story trophies come in sequence as long as you keep progressing the main missions, and this one unlocks as the mission wraps up.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Unlocks when Chapter 1 of the story is complete. Follow the main mission markers from the start of the game and finish every mission the chapter contains; the trophy pops at the chapter's end, so no side content needs to be cleared before you move on.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Unlocks when Chapter 2 of the story is complete. Keep following the main missions after Chapter 1; the chapter's final mission triggers the trophy. Nothing outside the campaign is required, so if it has not popped, a main mission in the chapter is still unfinished.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Unlocks when Chapter 3 of the story is complete. Play the campaign missions in order through the chapter; the trophy is awarded at the chapter's conclusion. Side activities can be left for later — only the chapter's main missions gate this one.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Unlocks when Chapter 4 of the story is complete. Continue the main mission chain; the trophy pops as the chapter closes. By this point the stranger strands are also open, but they are not needed here — the chapter's own missions are the whole requirement.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Awarded for completing the final mission of the story. Before you start it, finish any choice-sensitive or partner-dependent trophies you still need, because the ending is the point of no return the campaign builds toward; once the final mission is complete, the trophy unlocks during the closing scenes.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Awarded for completing the story mission Breakfast Run. It sits on the main campaign path, so it unlocks in sequence as you play; start the mission when its marker appears and complete its objectives from beginning to end.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Awarded for completing the story mission The Cartel Heist. Follow the campaign until the heist is offered, play it through its setup and finale, and the trophy unlocks when the mission is marked complete.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Awarded for completing the story mission Child's Play. It is part of the main campaign sequence, so keep progressing the story missions and finish this one when it arrives; the trophy pops at the mission's end.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Awarded for completing the story mission Headliners. Play the campaign through to this mission and complete it in full; like the other named-mission trophies it cannot be picked up out of order, so story progress is the only key.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Awarded for completing the story mission VCIA Takedown. Follow the main missions until the takedown is launched, complete its objectives, and the trophy unlocks as the mission closes.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Awarded for completing the story mission Operation Savage Glory. It belongs to the later campaign, so expect it after the earlier named missions; finish the operation's objectives end to end and the trophy is yours.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Attain 100% completion on the game's completion counter. This is the long-haul trophy: the story, stranger strands, collectibles, activities and challenges all feed the percentage, so leave it for the cleanup stage and work each remaining category systematically until the counter reads 100%.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts across Leonida. Stunt opportunities are spread over the whole map, so chip away at them whenever you pass one instead of grinding them all at the end; the counter is cumulative, and every stunt you register moves the total toward 250.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. Open the map and sample every distinct activity icon at least once — races, ranges, fishing, arcade games and the rest each count as a type — and the trophy unlocks when the last untried type has been attempted, win or lose.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges — 42 challenges in total, the count given for this trophy in the competition's own summary of the official list. Practise each weapon class until its gold score feels comfortable, and replay a challenge as often as needed; only the gold medal counts, one per challenge.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list
make.fun gta6-trophy-guide-01 competition rules (42 Shooting Range challenges)

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.countLabel: a win at every drone race location
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location. Entering each race is not enough — you must finish first at every site, so learn one course at a time, retry until the win registers, and tick the locations off the map one by one until none are left.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Repeats of a race you have already won do not add to the total, so keep moving to fresh race markers around the state; any race counts as long as each win is in a race you have not won before.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Accept Cal's challenge when it is offered and land the better catch under its rules; if you lose, challenge him again — the trophy only needs the one win, whenever it comes.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Find an arcade cabinet, start a game and play it through to its end rather than quitting mid-game; the trophy unlocks when one full arcade game has been completed.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy. Work through Andy's mission strand whenever its markers appear, finishing each job in order; the trophy pops at the end of the strand's last mission, so keep returning to Andy until no missions for him remain.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton. Kenton's strand unfolds over several jobs; finish each one as it appears and the trophy unlocks when the strand's final mission is complete and no Kenton markers are left on the map.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy. Follow Billy's strand from its first job to its last, completing each mission in sequence; the trophy is awarded at the end of the final one.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida. Each strand is a short chain of missions for one character — the strands for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone are five of them — and finishing any eight complete strands, start to finish, reaches the total.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy. Take Randy's jobs as they appear and work the strand to its end; the trophy unlocks when the final mission for Randy is complete.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone. Tyrone's strand is a chain of missions; finish them in order and the trophy pops when the last mission of the strand is done.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida. Meditation spots are fixed places in the world; visit each one and use the meditation prompt there. They are easy to drive past, so sweep the state region by region during cleanup until every spot has been used once.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Take Bret's hunting request and track the specific animal it names; an ordinary animal of the same species does not count — the trophy needs the unique hunt Bret sends you on to be completed and brought back to him.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets. Cards are hidden all over Leonida and each set is a defined group of them; focus on finishing whole sets rather than scattering pickups across all of them, and the third completed set unlocks the trophy.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. The WAiNK interaction is offered at spots around the state; use it at 100 different locations, because repeats at the same spot do not advance the counter — make a habit of using every new spot you pass.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. Challenges are the game's bite-size objectives and they accumulate as you play; any 50 completions count, so during cleanup pick off the quickest challenges still open until the total reaches 50.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat. Raise your wanted level to four stars while your partner is with you, then break line of sight and stay out of view until the stars clear; both the four stars and your partner's presence are required, so set the attempt up deliberately instead of hoping it happens by accident.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level. Chain the robberies inside one continuous wanted session: rob a shop, move straight to the next with your partner, and never let the wanted level fully clear between shops or the chain restarts.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. A vehicle counts as discovered when you get in and drive it, so hop into any parked model you have not driven before; traffic provides endless variety, and the 100th distinct vehicle unlocks the trophy.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Wait for a group of at least five enemies, trigger Combat Focus once, and drop all five before the effect ends; if it runs out at four, reposition, find the next group and try again — all five must fall inside one activation.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.missableNote: Flagged as possibly missable — an inference from the official description, which ties the act to one named place (VCIA) and a departure that is 'unscheduled', suggesting a specific window rather than free-roam repetition.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. VCIA is the airport, and the official wording points to leaving it in a way the schedule does not intend — take an aircraft out without clearance when the game gives you the chance. Because the description ties it to a specific place and moment, try it while the airport is open to you during the story rather than saving it for the very end.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The official description only hints — 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' — and the Rhino is the game's tank. Get into a Rhino and use it until the trophy registers; the wording suggests raising serious heat from inside the tank, so cause enough mayhem from the driver's seat for the hidden condition to trip.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Case the store first, go in quietly and complete the robbery without raising an alarm or being spotted; if you are detected, leave, let things cool down, and attempt the same store cleanly.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Each vault only counts when it ends in a successful escape — being caught or losing the take voids that vault — so plan your exit route before starting each robbery and repeat the job at five vaults.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Stop or breach a truck, take its cargo and get clear of the response that follows; the trophy needs the escape and not just the robbery, so have a fast vehicle ready before you hit it.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Every region of the state must be visited; use the still-grey pockets of your map as the guide and sweep each remaining area during cleanup, including the far corners, until the whole state has been uncovered.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. Every gang in the state must lose one operation to you, so vary your targets instead of hitting the same gang twice; once each gang has been robbed exactly once or more, the trophy unlocks.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.missableNote: Flagged as possibly missable — an inference from the official description: its name ('In The Beginning…') and its quiet, one-off wording suggest an early moment rather than a repeatable activity.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach and take the cocktail prompt at the spot with the view. The description reads like an early, quiet moment, so do it on an early visit to the beach instead of leaving it until the end of the game.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Take a car inside a showroom and drive it out through the glass; the trophy wants the dramatic exit, so put a showroom vehicle through the window rather than driving out of the door.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. Visit that named bowling alley and complete the action the description hints at — a proper follow-through, in bowling terms — at that specific alley; the description names the place, so other alleys do not count.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.missableNote: Flagged as possibly missable — an inference from the official description, which depends on 'a partnership' and gives no repeatable activity, suggesting a moment tied to your partner rather than a free-roam task.
trophies.guide: The official description is only a wink — 'A partnership with mass appeal.' It plainly involves your partner and something the two of you do together that draws an audience. Try partnered activities while both characters are together, and treat anything the pair do that pulls a crowd as the likely trigger.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.missableNote: Flagged as possibly missable — an inference from the official description: a trophy about 'choices made' can depend on which way a one-time decision goes, so the other branch may not offer it again in the same playthrough.
trophies.guide: Choices made (for better or worse), per the official description: this trophy is tied to a choice the story puts in front of you. When the game presents a clear either/or decision, see the choice through rather than avoiding it, and if the game lets you keep a save beforehand, do so — a choice, once made, defines the playthrough.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.missableNote: Flagged as possibly missable — an inference from the official description: 'Second time's the charm' implies a first attempt that goes wrong, and a specific first attempt may only happen once.
trophies.guide: Second time's the charm, per the official description: something must be attempted, go wrong, and then be done again successfully. If an attempt at a scored activity fails narrowly, retry it straight away instead of moving on — the trophy appears to reward the comeback, not the clean first try.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The official description asks 'What the hell just happened?' — this is the list's strange-secret trophy, tied to witnessing something unexplained out in Leonida. Explore off the beaten path, especially at night and away from the cities, and investigate anything that looks deliberately out of place until the encounter registers.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. While driving, use a melee attack from the vehicle to knock down pedestrians — ten-pin style, so a group is better than a single target. Find people gathered on a sidewalk, line the car up, and swing as you pass.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies; pass them to your laundering contacts instead of spending them raw and keep the cycle going — the counter is cumulative, and the trophy lands when the laundered total reaches a quarter of a million.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Spending in every shop feeds the one total — vehicles, clothes, weapons and services all count — so there is no need to save for a single spree; ordinary purchases across the game accumulate until the counter reaches six figures.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Every garage offered for sale in the state must end up bought; they appear as property purchases, so during cleanup check the map for any garage still for sale and buy the remaining ones until none are left.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. When you take a vehicle you want to keep, register it through the app there and then; ten registrations in total unlock the trophy, so register vehicles as you acquire them rather than batching the job at the end.
sources: Official PS5 trophy list (PlayStation), as listed by Exophase
PSNProfiles trophy list
